## Purpose
Project-level config and tooling for the portfolio, a fork of GitProfile built with Vite, React and TypeScript. `gitprofile.config.ts` holds all site content and feature toggles, `vite.config.ts` wires it into the build, and `global.d.ts` declares the global config types. It is used by running the npm scripts against these files; no application code lives here.

## Key concepts
- `gitprofile.config.ts` exports the `CONFIG` object (GitHub username, projects, SEO, social, resume, blog, books, theme, PWA); see [[src-interfaces]] for the sanitized shape.
- `vite.config.ts` injects `CONFIG` as the compile-time global `CONFIG` via `define`, and feeds SEO fields into `index.html` through `vite-plugin-html`.
- `global.d.ts` declares ambient types (`Config`, `Github`, `Projects`, `ThemeConfig`, ...) with no imports needed; consumed by [[src-utils]] and [[src-components]].
- `VitePWA` is only added when `CONFIG.enablePWA` is truthy.

## Gotchas
- `CONFIG` is a Vite `define` global, so `src/main.tsx` uses it without importing; config edits need a dev-server restart.
- `base` is `'./'` (relative) for GitHub Pages deployment; changing it affects asset paths.
